verdict.rationale: Gram ships a first-party `gram` CLI with a dedicated command-line reference, and a probe confirms that page exists. The CLI handles authentication, staging OpenAPI documents and Functions, pushing and monitoring deployments, and installing toolsets as MCP servers into AI agents, which covers AI-native workflows directly. It also keeps itself up to date. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI working as documented.
